container_image.Description: Use a container image to start the notebook instance.

repository.Description:
The path to the container image repository.
For example: gcr.io/{project_id}/{imageName}

tag.Description: The tag of the container image. If not specified, this defaults to the latest tag.

description.Description: A brief description of this environment.

display_name.Description: Display name of this environment for the UI.

location.Description: A reference to the zone where the machine resides.

name.Description:
The name specified for the Environment instance.
Format: projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/environments/{environmentId}

post_startup_script.Description:
Path to a Bash script that automatically runs after a notebook instance fully boots up.
The path must be a URL or Cloud Storage path. Example: "gs://path-to-file/file-name"

vm_image.Description: Use a Compute Engine VM image to start the notebook instance.

image_family.Description: Use this VM image family to find the image; the newest image in this family will be used.

image_name.Description: Use VM image name to find the image.

project.Description:
The name of the Google Cloud project that this VM image belongs to.
Format: projects/{project_id}
